content: Womu ɡe Dɑfidi u kuɑ. U nɛɛ,

content.text: kon Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑ.
Kon win yĩsi dɛɛrɑru tɔmɑ kɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru kpuro.
Kon Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑ.
Win ye u kuɑ, nɑ ǹ duɑrimɔ, bɑɑ yen tiɑ.
U rɑ mɑn nɛn torɑnu kpuro suuru kue.
U rɑ nɛn bɑrɑnu kpuro kpeesie.
U rɑ mɑn yɑre sɑɑ siki wɔrun di.
U rɑ mɑn durom kɑ wɔnwɔndu kue.
U rɑ nɛn wɑ̃ɑru doo nɔɔru yibie.
Kpɑ u mɑn ko nɡe ɑluwɑɑsi nɛn tɔkɔru sɔɔ,
nɑ n dɑm mɔ nɡe ɡunɔ bɑkeru te tɑ yɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ siriwɑ ɡem sɔɔ.
U rɑ be bɑ dɑm dɔremɔ wɔre.
U Mɔwisi win woodɑbɑ sɔ̃ɔsi.
Mɑ u Isirelibɑ win sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Yinni Gusunɔ u wɔnwɔndu mɔ.
U rɑ mɑɑ tɔnu durom kue.
Win durom mu kpɑ̃.
Win mɔru ku rɑ se fuuku.
U ku rɑ tɔmbu ɡerusi kiri kiri.
U ku rɑ mɑɑ mɔru ko n kɑ tɛ.
U ku rɑ sun sɛɛyɑsie nɡe mɛ bɛsɛn torɑrɑ nɛ.
U ku rɑ sun bɛsɛn torɑnu kɔsie.
Adɑmɑ nɡe mɛ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru tɑ kɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru tondinɛ,
nɡe mɛyɑ u rɑ mɑɑ bɛsɛn torɑnu tondɑsie.
Nɡe mɛ wɔllɑ kɑ tem tomɑ,
nɡe mɛyɑ win durom mu kpɑ̃ɑru nɛ be bɑ nùn nɑsien mi.
Nɡe mɛ tundo u rɑ n win bibun wɔnwɔndu mɔ,
nɡe mɛyɑ Yinni u be bɑ nùn nɑsien wɔnwɔndu mɔ.
Domi u yɛ̃ ye bɑ kɑ sun tɑkɑ kuɑ.
U ǹ duɑri mɑ yɑnimɑ bɑ kɑ sun mɔmɑ.
Tɔnun wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃nu nu ku rɑ tɛ.
Nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe yɑkɑsu.
U rɑ sewɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ wɛ̃su.
Woo ɡɑ̀ n su swee kpɑ su doonɑ.
Bɑɑ sin yĩreru ɑ ǹ mɑɑ wɑsi.
Adɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔn durom mu rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ
be bɑ nùn nɑsien mi, mɑ bɑ win ɑrukɑwɑni nɛni,
mɑ bɑ win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ win ɡem mu rɑ n kɑ bu wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ ben bibun bibɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u win sinɑ ɡɔnɑ tɛriɑ wɔllɔ.
Mɑ u bɑndu dii ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuron wɔllɔ.
Bɛɛ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdobɑ, bɛɛ be i dɑm mɔ
i rɑ win ɡɑri mɛm nɔɔwɛ, i nùn siɑro.
Bɛɛ win tɑbu kowobu kpuro,
bɛɛ be i nùn sɑ̃ɑmɔ,
i win kĩru mɔ̀,
i nùn siɑro.
Bɛɛ win tɑkɑ koorɑ, i nùn siɑro mi u bɑndu dii kpuro.
Yinni Gusunɔ, kon nun siɑrɑ.
